name: @DeFlow/e2e
description: Cross-process specs. What they exercise is the DeFlow binary and a real DeFlowd process; @DeFlow/core, @DeFlow/ledger and @DeFlow/testkit are devDependencies used only to arrange a data directory before a daemon is started over it and to read one back afterwards, and @DeFlow/adapters only so a spec asserting 'no vendor agent CLI is on this PATH' can read the binary names out of PROVIDER_SPECS rather than keeping a second list of them. @DeFlow/daemon is deliberately absent: R2 keeps it a leaf.
